Khamoshi sunne ka art hai.
Grit sapnon ko plans banata.
Meri rooh us khamoshi se peace mein hai.
Grit goals ko realities banata.
Failure se seekhte; persistence se success.
Chuppi gyaan ki raksha karti hai.
Bahadur bolte jab zaroori ho; samajhdar bolte jab ho sake.
Khamoshi wahi hai jahan strength accumulate hoti.
Grit discipline hai jo persistence pehenti.
Himmat mazedaar hai.
Duniya sab ko todti; strong banao.
Aag se guzarna hi himmat hai.
Quiet mind loud mind se zyada strong hota.
Nadiyan yeh jaanti hain ki koi jaldi nahi hai, hum ek din wahan pahunch hi jayenge.
Khamoshi ko suno.
Bravery woh hai jo akela bhi chalte rehta hai.
Silence empty nahi—yeh answers se full hota hai.
Jo dusron ko jeete woh balwaan hai.
Grit rukavaton ko paar karti hai.
Apne sapno ko kabhi mat chhodo.
